importer_warning_finding: Both padding warnings are false alarms: the scene is correct (1600 per-face colours for 1600 faces with colorPerVertex false; texCoordIndex never exceeds 2). The importer's _index_need takes the maximum over coordIndex as well, which the X3D rules only allow when colorPerVertex is true and colorIndex is empty (likewise texCoordIndex). Padding is appended after the used values, so the import is unaffected. Grade: Confirmed (read in import_x3d.py lines 2301 and 2359).
